Package org.unitseek.knitid.core.exception

Class IdErrorCodes

java.lang.Object
org.unitseek.knitid.core.exception.IdErrorCodes
public final class IdErrorCodes extends Object
Stable error codes. The values are part of the public contract.

Codes are grouped as configuration (1000), generation (2000), parsing (3000) and registry (4000) failures.

Since:
1.0.0
